1girl, solo, half body, upper body character portrait, looking at viewer, confident smile, small fang. A relaxed standing pose in a slight three-quarter view; face turned toward the viewer.

A single finished game character illustration of Wu.

Vertical waist-up composition cropped at the hips. Entire head, ponytail root, hair bow, shoulders and waist stay inside the frame with comfortable margins. Arms rest naturally by her sides and continue below the crop. Sword remains sheathed on her back, with its black hilt visible behind her right shoulder (on the left side of the image). Plain warm light-gray background, no scenery.

Soft neutral daylight, restrained cool shadows, bright clear face, matte charcoal fabric, broad silver hair color planes, blue ribbon as the color accent.
